description: This file implements Bluetooth ISO (Isochronous) peripheral operations within the Zephyr RTOS Bluetooth controller, including handling CIS (Connected Isochronous Stream) acquisition, setup, acceptance, rejection, and resource management, as well as ticker updates and peer SCA updates.

methods.name: ll_cis_get_acl_awaiting_reply
methods.description: Retrieves the ACL connection associated with a CIS handle if it exists and is in the correct state.

methods.name: ll_cis_accept
methods.description: Accepts a CIS request, calculating minimum offset based on configuration and connection parameters.

methods.name: ll_cis_reject
methods.description: Rejects a CIS request with a specified reason.

methods.name: ull_peripheral_iso_release
methods.description: Releases resources for a CIS/CIG on aborted setup.

methods.name: ull_peripheral_iso_acquire
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a CIG and CIS for a given ACL connection based on a request.

methods.name: ull_peripheral_iso_setup
methods.description: Sets up a CIS with parameters received from a CIS indication.

methods.name: ull_peripheral_iso_update_ticker
methods.description: Updates the ticker timing for a CIG.

methods.name: ull_peripheral_iso_update_peer_sca
methods.description: Updates the peer SCA (Sleep Clock Accuracy) for a connection.
